newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA TO HOST BALTIC CENTRAL BANK SEMINAR.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA TO HOST BALTIC CENTRAL BANK SEMINAR.

text.p: The Estonian central bank said on Monday that it will host a seminar on the central banks of the Baltic states on May 29-30.

The seminar, which will mark the fifth anniversary of the reintroduction of the kroon, will be held in the coastal town of Parnu in south-western Estonia and will focus on many key aspects of the roles of central banks.
"We wanted a seminar that was our contribution to Baltic cooperation," Kaja Kell, of the Estonian central bank's information office, told Reuters.
"There is a need for cooperation between the central banks, beacuse although there are differences in approaches, the similarities between the countries make the seminar important," she added.
The seminar goes beyond the Baltic states with participants in the working groups from countries such as Finland, Poland and the Czech Republic and international finance organisations.
The work groups will focus on monetary policy, financial mediation and banking organisation and management, the bank said in a statement.
A sub-theme in the seminar will focus on the impact of European economic and monetary union.
